approach: Create crates/athena-data/src/history.rs holding six structs (LandingIntent, Landing, DeclaredIntervention, Checkpoint, LegacyExempt, ImportManifest) plus a separate internally tagged enum HistoryRecord (serde tag "schema", deny_unknown_fields on each struct) with parse(bytes) and validate(). The new enum is not added to the existing AnyRecord, so records/ routing, check_record_file and the history check are untouched. Validation helpers check for non-empty trimmed strings, 40 lowercase hex shas, 64 hex SHA-256 digests, and non-empty required lists. Tests sit in history.rs. Export the module in lib.rs, add a pointer doc line in records.rs, and add a CHANGELOG entry.

decisions.choice: New schema tags: athena.landing-intent/1, athena.landing/1, athena.declared-intervention/1, athena.checkpoint/1, athena.legacy-exempt/1, athena.import-manifest/1. Rust type for the intervention is DeclaredIntervention.
decisions.reason: records.rs already has AnyRecord::Intervention tagged athena.intervention/1 and an InterventionCategory enum. Reusing either name would collide in serde or confuse readers. Design §5.3 calls it 'intervention (declared)'.

rejected.why: Collides with the existing record type and its tests.

decisions.choice: A separate HistoryRecord enum in history.rs, not new variants of AnyRecord.
decisions.reason: AnyRecord drives path routing and the history check; adding variants would change records/ handling, which is out of scope. The new records live on a different branch with their own paths.

rejected.why: Touches existing exhaustive matches (schema(), path logic) and risks changing history-check behaviour.

decisions.choice: Validate shas with a local helper (len 40, chars 0-9a-f) and SHA-256 as 64 lowercase hex. No new dependency.
decisions.reason: Simple; Cargo.toml needs no change. The deliverable listing for Cargo.toml is left unmodified unless the producer finds a need.

rejected.option: Add a hex or regex crate
rejected.why: Not worth a dependency (buy-first) for a one-line check.

decisions.choice: Fields: LandingIntent{id, at, pr_number, head_sha, head_tree_sha, expected_base, job_ids}; Landing{id, at, pr_number, head_sha, host_commit, merge_method, commits:[{sha,tree,job,verification}], intent}; DeclaredIntervention{id, at, declarer, reason, commit_sha}; Checkpoint{id, at, main_sha, records_sha, verifier_version}; LegacyExempt{entries:[{sha,reason}]}; ImportManifest{c0, entries:[{path, blob_id, sha256}]}.
decisions.reason: Matches §4, §5.3 and §9. Reuse JobId and RecordId from crate::id and Timestamp from jiff, as records.rs does. Merge method is an enum (squash, merge, rebase) or a validated non-empty string; use the enum with snake_case serde.

files.purpose: Six record structs, the HistoryRecord enum, validation helpers and tests.
Add `pub mod history;` and a bullet in the crate docs.
Doc-only pointer saying the records-branch types live in history.rs and that athena.intervention/1 is unrelated; no behaviour change.
Entry naming the six new record types.

steps: Read the top of CHANGELOG.md and the id module (JobId, RecordId) for conventions.

Create history.rs: sha and sha256 validators, the six structs with deny_unknown_fields and doc comments citing the design section and D111, the HistoryRecord enum with schema tags and schema(), and parse/validate.
Add validate() per struct: non-empty trimmed strings, 40-hex shas, non-empty lists (landing commits, manifest entries and legacy entries may need at least one entry), PR number > 0.
Add tests: round trip, schema tag in text, and rejection of empty field, unknown field, bad sha, wrong tag, athena.intervention/1 body.
Add `pub mod history;` to lib.rs; add a doc pointer in records.rs.
Run cargo fmt, clippy --all-targets and cargo test --workspace.

risks.risk: Schema or name clash with the existing intervention record.
risks.mitigation: Use schema tag athena.declared-intervention/1 and a separate enum; a test asserts that an athena.intervention/1 body is rejected by HistoryRecord::parse.

risks.risk: Accidental change to the history check or records routing.
risks.mitigation: Do not touch AnyRecord; grep confirms no other crate imports history.

risks.risk: Sha validation too loose or too strict.
risks.mitigation: Tests assert sha is exactly 40 chars, lowercase hex; reject uppercase.

demonstrations.method: Unit tests, one per type: build a valid value, serialize with to_pretty_json, assert the text contains the type's schema tag, parse with HistoryRecord::parse, assert equality with the original.
demonstrations.observes: Six round-trip tests pass; each checks the schema tag in the JSON text and value equality after the round trip.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the tag or serde derives were missing, the text would lack the schema string or the parsed value would differ or fail to parse.

demonstrations.method: Rejection tests per type. They cover an empty required field, an unknown JSON field, a sha of uppercase, short or non-hex form, and a wrong schema tag (for example landing with the checkpoint's tag, or athena.landing/9). They also check that the valid examples return Ok.
demonstrations.observes: parse or validate returns Err for each malformed case and Ok for each valid example.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without validate(), empty fields and bad shas would be accepted; without deny_unknown_fields, the unknown-field case would parse.

demonstrations.method: Run the full workspace tests. Also run cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets and cargo fmt --check, which are separate commands the verifier may run. Use git diff to confirm no existing test text changed.
demonstrations.observes: All pass; existing records and history-check tests are untouched and still green.

demonstrations.method: Read the diff: every pub item in history.rs has a doc comment citing docs/design/records-history.md with §5.3, §4 or §8 and D111. Field sets match the design list. Run cargo doc is not needed.
demonstrations.observes: Doc comments and fields present as listed in criterion 4.

demonstrations.method: Inspect the changed-file list and Grep for HistoryRecord or history:: use outside athena-data. No file under athena-core, athena-cli, athena-gate or records/ is changed, and history.rs has no git or branch code.
demonstrations.observes: Only the deliverable files change; no writer or host-check code exists.
A new entry names landing-intent, landing, intervention (declared), checkpoint, legacy-exempt and import-manifest in athena-data.

open_questions: Exact CHANGELOG section and format (Unreleased heading) was not read; the producer should follow the file's top entries.
Whether the merge method should be an enum or a free string; the design only says 'the merge method'. Plan uses an enum of squash, merge and rebase.
crates/athena-data/Cargo.toml is a listed deliverable, but no dependency change is expected.
